turns.q: Can you explain the main options in simple terms?
turns.replyTail: Register your purifier to activate the Forever Guarantee: you’ll log into your Alen account and complete Register your purifier in the onboarding flow. - Set up a filter subscription: choose Subscribe & Save, then pick what kind of filter you want and how often you want replacements. - Set up subscription payment: use Set up payment to add your preferred payment method. - Connect the app: connect your purifier to WiFi using the Alen Air app so you can control it remotely and monitor air quality.

turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail: : To use it properly the very first time, follow the quickstart guide: 1. Take your Alen out of the box and remove all protective films. - Note: Your filter is already inside your unit, so you'll need to open your front panel to unwrap your filter! 2. Now find a good spot for your purifier. - We recommend placing your Alen along your room's longest wall, at least 18 inches away from furniture. 3. Plug in your Alen and press the button to turn it on. Leave your Alen running 24/7 for best results!
